pairs.rationale: Both reports describe the same critical checkout failure: HTTP 500 error when clicking 'Pagar ahora'/'Place order', preventing order creation across all platforms since version 4.2.0. They provide consistent reproduction steps and impact.
Both reports describe the identical checkout payment failure: HTTP 500 error on the order creation endpoint after version 4.2.0, affecting all platforms, with the same reproduction steps and impact.

inc-0001 reports checkout payment failure with HTTP 500; inc-0011 reports app crash when opening order history. These are different features (payment vs. order history view) and different defects despite sharing the word 'order'.

inc-0001 reports checkout payment failure with HTTP 500; inc-0013 reports app crash when opening order history. These are different defects in different features (checkout vs. order history) despite both involving orders.

inc-0001 reports HTTP 500 at payment step; inc-0025 reports blank screen at shipping step with a JavaScript TypeError. These are different checkout steps with different root causes (server error vs. client-side undefined property).

inc-0001 reports checkout payment failure with HTTP 500; inc-0026 reports empty order history after database migration. These are different features and different defects (order creation vs. order display).
inc-0001 reports checkout payment failure with HTTP 500; inc-0031 reports admin backend button failure. These are different features and systems (customer checkout vs. admin order management).
inc-0001 reports checkout payment failure with HTTP 500; inc-0039 reports missing accents in checkout label text. These are completely different defects (functionality vs. localization).

inc-0001 reports checkout payment HTTP 500 error affecting all platforms in version 4.2.0; inc-0044 reports iOS app crash on saved card selection in payment step in version 4.1.3. Different root causes and versions.
inc-0001 reports checkout payment failure with HTTP 500; inc-0047 reports missing cancellation email. These are different features and different defects (order creation vs. email delivery).

inc-0001 reports a general checkout failure with HTTP 500 on payment. inc-0059 reports a specific payment validation issue where expired cards are not rejected. These are different defects in different systems.
Both reports describe the same defect: HTTP 500 error when placing an order after the 4.2.0 deployment, preventing all users from checking out. The defect in both is the order creation API failure.
inc-0002 reports checkout failing with HTTP 500 on order creation. inc-0005 reports double charging due to payment confirmation retries. These are different root causes and symptoms.

inc-0002 reports checkout HTTP 500 during order placement. inc-0011 reports app crash when opening order history for users with 100+ orders. These occur at different features and for different reasons.
inc-0002 reports checkout HTTP 500 preventing order creation. inc-0013 reports app crash when opening order history. These are different features and different defects.

inc-0002 reports checkout HTTP 500 on order placement. inc-0023 reports missing webhooks for new-order events since 2 days ago. These are different symptoms; one is checkout failure, the other is webhook delivery.

inc-0002 reports checkout HTTP 500 preventing order creation since 4.2.0 deploy. inc-0024 reports webhook dispatcher showing 0 deliveries for order.created since 4.2.0. The checkout failure could cause no orders to be created, explaining missing webhooks. These likely describe the same root defect.
inc-0002 reports checkout HTTP 500 on order creation. inc-0042 reports cart data leakage between customers at checkout via CDN caching. These are distinct defects in different components.

inc-0002 reports checkout HTTP 500 preventing order placement. inc-0059 reports expired saved cards not being validated until payment attempt. These are different defects: one is API failure, the other is validation logic.

inc-0003 reports HTTP 500 on order placement preventing order creation. inc-0005 reports customers being charged twice due to payment confirmation retries. One is an API failure, the other is a double-charge issue. Different defects.
inc-0003 reports HTTP 500 on Place order preventing order creation; inc-0008 reports duplicate push notifications on order shipment. These are different defects in different parts of the order flow.
inc-0003 reports HTTP 500 during checkout/order placement; inc-0011 reports app crash when opening order history with 100+ orders. These are different defects in different features.

inc-0003 reports HTTP 500 during order placement on checkout; inc-0013 reports app closing when opening order history with many orders. These are different defects at different stages (creating vs. viewing orders).

inc-0003 reports HTTP 500 preventing order creation; inc-0023 reports missing webhooks for new orders. These are related symptoms but different defects: one prevents orders from being placed, the other affects downstream webhook delivery.

inc-0003 reports HTTP 500 on Place order with no orders created; inc-0024 reports no webhook deliveries for order.created since 4.2.0 deploy. The same root cause (order creation failing) could explain both: if orders aren't created, webhooks won't fire. This is one defect with multiple symptoms.

inc-0003 reports HTTP 500 on Place order in the storefront; inc-0031 reports error marking orders as sent in admin. These are different defects in different interfaces (customer checkout vs. admin operations).

inc-0003 reports HTTP 500 during order placement; inc-0043 reports search showing unavailable products. These are different defects in different features (checkout failure vs. search filtering issue).

inc-0003 reports HTTP 500 on Place order; inc-0044 reports iOS app crash when selecting saved payment method. These are different defects: one is a server error, the other is an app crash at a different step.

inc-0003 reports HTTP 500 on Place order preventing order creation; inc-0047 reports cancellation emails not being sent. These are different defects in different features (order placement vs. cancellation email logic).
inc-0004 (Spanish) and inc-0005 (English) both describe customers being charged twice for a single order due to payment gateway retry/timeout logic. Same defect reported by different users/languages.
Both reports describe the same defect: customers charged twice for a single order, visible in bank statements but appearing once in the system.
inc-0004 is duplicate push notifications for shipment notifications (in Spanish), while inc-0004 is about double charges during payment. Different features affected.
inc-0004 is double charges during payment; inc-0008 is duplicate push notifications for shipment. Different features and defects.
inc-0004 is double charges during payment; inc-0021 is addresses duplicating when edited. Different features and defects.
Both describe the same defect: customers charged twice for one order due to payment confirmation retry after timeout. Same issue, different languages.
inc-0005 is double payment charges; inc-0007 is duplicate push notifications for shipment. Different defects in different features.
inc-0005 is double payment charges; inc-0008 is duplicate shipment push notifications. Different defects in different features.
inc-0005 is double payment charges; inc-0042 is CDN caching issue showing other customers' carts. Different defects.
inc-0005 is double payment charges; inc-0047 is missing cancellation email. Different defects in different features.
inc-0005 is double payment charges; inc-0059 is expired card accepted at checkout. Different defects in payment flow.

inc-0006 reports a payment processing defect where a customer was charged twice but the order appears only once. inc-0007 reports a duplicate push notification about shipment status. These are completely different defects in different features.
inc-0006 reports a payment processing defect with double charges. inc-0008 reports duplicate push notifications for order shipment. These are different defects in different features.

inc-0007 (Spanish) and inc-0008 (English) both describe the same defect: users receiving duplicate push notifications saying 'Tu pedido va en camino'/'Your order is on its way' when an order ships. Same feature, same symptom, just different languages.

inc-0007 reports duplicate push notifications on shipment status. inc-0021 reports saved addresses being duplicated when edited. These are different defects in different features (notifications vs. address management).
inc-0008 reports duplicate push notifications for shipped orders. inc-0011 reports the app crashing when opening order history. These are different defects in different features.
inc-0008 reports duplicate push notifications for shipments. inc-0042 reports a caching issue where customers see each other's cart items. These are completely different defects.

inc-0008 reports duplicate push notifications for shipped orders. inc-0050 reports incorrect currency labels in price-drop push notifications. These are different push notification issues in different features.

inc-0009 (Spanish) and inc-0010 (English) both describe the exact same defect: the 'Save' button on the profile page is not translated to Spanish and remains in English. Same feature, same bug, different language reports.

inc-0009 reports an untranslated 'Save' button on the profile page. inc-0037 reports an untranslated login error message. These are different UI elements with translation issues, likely different bugs to fix.

inc-0010 reports an untranslated 'Save' button on the profile page. inc-0037 reports an untranslated login error message. These are different UI elements with translation issues, likely different bugs to fix.

inc-0010 reports an untranslated 'Save' button on the Spanish profile page; inc-0051 reports long product titles being truncated without a tooltip. These are entirely different defects in different features.

inc-0011 describes a crash when opening order history for users with 100+ orders; inc-0012 provides the same crash with technical details (IndexOutOfBoundsException at index 100) confirming it's the same defect.

inc-0011 reports app crash opening order history for users with 100+ orders on Android; inc-0013 describes the app closing when opening order list after having many orders. Both describe the same crash on order history for users with high order counts.

inc-0011 reports a crash in the Android order history screen; inc-0023 reports missing webhooks for order.created events. These are completely different defects in different systems (mobile app vs webhooks).
inc-0011 reports Android order history crash; inc-0044 reports iOS payment screen crash with saved cards. These are different crashes on different platforms in different features.
inc-0011 reports Android order history crash; inc-0047 reports missing order cancellation emails. These are completely different defects in different features.
inc-0011 reports Android order history crash; inc-0049 reports search autocomplete lag on older iPhones. These are different defects on different features and platforms.
inc-0011 reports Android app crash on order history; inc-0051 reports web product title truncation. These are different defects on different platforms in different features.

inc-0012 shows IndexOutOfBoundsException crash on order history with 2,310 events in 24h; inc-0013 describes the app closing when opening order list after having many orders. Both describe the same order history crash for users with many orders.

inc-0013 reports order history causing app to close for a user with many orders; inc-0026 (in Spanish) reports order history showing empty after database migration, affecting thousands of users. These are different defects: one is a crash, the other is missing data.
inc-0013 reports app crash when opening order history on Samsung phone; inc-0027 reports incorrect pricing display in app vs web. These are completely different defects affecting different features.

Both reports describe blurry/pixelated product images on tablet devices (iPad Pro and Galaxy Tab), with inc-0014 suggesting thumbnails are loaded instead of full resolution images, and inc-0015 reporting poor image quality on tablets. This is the same defect reported on different tablet brands.

inc-0014 reports pixelated product images on iPad (thumbnails loading instead of full images); inc-0033 reports slow image loading on 3G connections. The root cause and user impact differ—one is a display/loading issue, the other is a network speed issue.

inc-0014 reports blurry product images on iPad; inc-0051 reports truncated product titles with no tooltip on web. These affect different UI elements (images vs text) on different platforms (mobile app vs web).
inc-0015 reports poor image quality on tablets; inc-0032 reports missing size table on mobile web. These are different defects affecting different UI components (product images vs size table).

Both reports describe slow search in the app (6-8 seconds delay) compared to instant web search. inc-0016 provides quantified metrics, inc-0017 describes the same issue in casual terms—same defect, same feature.

Both reports describe slow app search taking 6-8 seconds (inc-0016) and high latency on /search endpoint at 7.8s p95 (inc-0018). inc-0018 identifies the technical root cause (old index) of the same search performance problem.
inc-0016 reports slow search in app; inc-0027 reports incorrect pricing display in app. These are distinct defects in different features (search performance vs price accuracy).

inc-0016 reports slow search in app on 4G; inc-0033 reports slow image loading on 3G. While both involve app performance delays, they affect different features (search vs images) under different network conditions.
inc-0016 reports slow search in the customer app on 4G; inc-0035 reports slow customer search in the admin panel. These are different applications/modules with different performance issues.

Inc-0016 reports overall search slowness (6-8s on mobile 4G vs instant on web). Inc-0049 reports autocomplete lag (1s per keystroke on older iPhones). These are different defects: one is search result display latency, the other is input responsiveness during typing.

Both incidents report the same defect: slow search on the app (takes a long time to load results) versus fast search on web. Inc-0018 provides technical details (endpoint latency p95 7.8s vs 300ms, missing new index) explaining the same user-visible problem reported in inc-0017.

Inc-0017 reports slow search results loading on the app. Inc-0027 reports incorrect product prices displayed on the app. These are completely different defects affecting different features (search performance vs price display).

Inc-0017 reports slow search on the app. Inc-0033 reports slow image loading on 3G. While both involve app slowness, they affect different features: search functionality vs image rendering. These are different defects.

Inc-0017 reports slow search in the customer-facing app. Inc-0035 reports slow customer search in the admin panel. These are search slowness in different areas of the system (customer app vs admin), so they are different defects.

Inc-0017 reports search results taking a long time to load on the app. Inc-0049 reports autocomplete lag during typing. These are different defects: one is result display latency, the other is input responsiveness.
Inc-0018 reports slow /search endpoint on app (7.8s vs 300ms web). Inc-0033 reports slow image loading on 3G. Different defects: search endpoint performance vs image asset loading performance.

Inc-0018 reports slow search endpoint on the mobile app. Inc-0035 reports slow search in the admin panel. While both are search slowness, they occur in different systems (app vs admin), representing different defects.

Inc-0018 reports slow search endpoint response times on the app (latency issue). Inc-0043 reports search returning wrong results (products not available in user's region). These are different defects: performance vs incorrect search results filtering.

Inc-0018 reports slow search endpoint on mobile app (7.8s p95 response time). Inc-0049 reports autocomplete lag during keystroke input. Different defects: search result latency vs input field responsiveness.

inc-0019 reports password reset emails missing for Hotmail/Outlook users. inc-0020 reports the same issue from a user's perspective requesting password reset on Outlook. Both describe the same defect.
inc-0019 reports password reset emails missing for Hotmail/Outlook. inc-0045 reports changing email address in profile shows saved but old email persists. Different features and defects.
inc-0019 reports password reset emails missing for Hotmail/Outlook. inc-0047 reports order cancellation emails not sent. Different email types and likely different causes.
inc-0020 reports missing password reset email on Outlook. inc-0045 reports email change not saving in profile. Different defects in different features.
inc-0021 (Spanish) reports saved addresses duplicating when edited on web. inc-0022 (Spanish) reports duplicate addresses in app Android profile. Same defect across platforms.
inc-0023 reports missing new-order webhooks and empty delivery log. inc-0024 reports webhook dispatcher showing 0 deliveries for order.created since deploy. Same webhook defect.
inc-0023 reports missing order.created webhooks. inc-0026 reports empty order history after database migration. Different issues: webhooks vs. data visibility.
inc-0023 reports missing order webhooks. inc-0047 reports missing order cancellation emails. Both involve orders but different systems (webhooks vs. email).
inc-0024 reports order.created webhooks not sending since 4.2.0 deploy. inc-0031 reports 'Mark as sent' button error in admin. Different features and systems.
inc-0025 reports blank shipping page with TypeError about undefined 'zones'. inc-0031 reports admin 'Mark as sent' button error. Different features and errors.

inc-0025 reports a critical crash on the shipping step with a TypeError preventing checkout completion. inc-0039 reports a missing accent on a label in the checkout. These are fundamentally different issues: a blocking crash vs. a cosmetic text error.

inc-0026 reports missing order history for thousands of users since a database migration. inc-0030 reports the cart being empty after logout. These are different features affected by different root causes: order history retrieval vs. session/cart persistence.

inc-0026 reports missing order history since database migration affecting customer-facing order retrieval. inc-0031 reports an admin button error preventing order status updates. These are different defects in different parts of the system with different root causes.

inc-0026 reports missing order history for users since migration. inc-0034 reports a sales report in admin not including orders with coupons. These are different issues: user order visibility vs. admin reporting logic for filtered data.

inc-0027 reports the app showing outdated lower prices than the web, causing overcharge complaints. inc-0050 reports push notifications showing USD label instead of MXN. These are different defects: price currency/freshness mismatch vs. notification currency label display.

inc-0031 reports an admin button error for marking orders as shipped. inc-0034 reports admin sales report not summing orders with coupons. These are different functionality issues in different parts of the admin: order management vs. reporting.

inc-0031 reports an admin button error for marking orders as shipped. inc-0039 reports a missing accent on a checkout label. These are in different areas with completely different root causes: admin order status functionality vs. frontend text formatting.

inc-0031 reports an admin button error for shipping status. inc-0043 reports search showing region-inappropriate products. These are completely different defects in different features: admin order management vs. search filtering logic.

inc-0031 reports an admin button error for marking orders as shipped. inc-0047 reports cancellation emails not being sent. These are different defects: admin UI functionality vs. email notification delivery.

inc-0033 reports product images taking 10+ seconds on 3G in the app. inc-0058 reports category page taking 11-14 seconds initially on the web at 50 Mbps. Both describe slow product catalog loading on initial load, likely the same performance issue across platforms with different network conditions.
First report: customer search in admin is slow (15 seconds). Second report: order timestamps display in UTC instead of local time. These are completely different defects in different features.
First report: TiendaLite logo appears stretched in Outlook emails. Second report: missing accents on checkout text ('Direccion' vs 'Dirección'). Different issues in different environments.
First report: TiendaLite logo stretched in Outlook emails. Second report: payment card logos have mismatched sizes on web checkout. Both involve logos but in different contexts and environments.

First report: missing accents on checkout shipping text ('Direccion de envio'). Second report: search shows products unavailable in user's region. Completely different defects in different parts of the checkout flow.

First report: missing accents on Spanish text in checkout ('Direccion de envio'). Second report: typo 'Adress' instead of 'Address' in English shipping form. Both are text/spelling issues in checkout but in different languages and different defects (accents vs typo).
First report: amounts left-aligned in admin tables, hard to compare. Second report: order timestamps show in UTC instead of local time. Different defects affecting admin display.
First report: amounts left-aligned in admin tables. Second report: Reports icon in sidebar is 3px misaligned. Different admin UI formatting/alignment issues in different components.

First report: search results show products not available in user's region (Mexican users see US products). Second report: push notifications show incorrect currency label (USD instead of MXN). Both relate to regional/localization issues but affect different features with different problems.
First report: search results show unavailable products for the user's region. Second report: long product titles are truncated without tooltip. Different defects in the search/product display area.

First report: iOS app crashes when selecting a saved card, with a specific crash log. Second report: expired saved cards are accepted in checkout and only fail at final payment. Different defects: one is a crash on selection, the other is validation failure at payment time.
inc-0046 reports order times displaying in UTC instead of Mexico City timezone in admin. inc-0050 reports push notifications showing USD label for MXN prices. Different features, different defects.
inc-0056 reports inconsistent logo sizes on payment step. inc-0059 reports expired saved cards being accepted until final payment fails. Different defects in payment UI.
